question.text: The compound with molecular formula $\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_6$, which gives only one monobromo derivative and takes up four moles of hydrogen per mole for complete hydrogenation has ________ $=$ electrons.

solution.text:
Since 4 moles of $\mathrm{H}_2$ is being added for complete hydrogenation the degree of unsaturation $=4$

No. of $\pi$ electrons in $\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_6=4 \times 2=8$
